clue.text: Animal doctor tense after sheep rejected

indicators.note: after tells us the sheep part comes before the doctor and tense
rejected is read as sent back, so the word for sheep runs backwards here

parts.note: a ram is a male sheep
MO is Medical Officer, a military doctor
T is the grammar abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: A vet stressed after a flock of sheep turned him away.
explanation.definitionFit: A marmot is a burrowing rodent of the squirrel family, so it is a kind of animal.

clue.text: Distant relation needs to be up, keeping on the ball

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters read from bottom to top, so they run backwards
keeping means holding within, so the letters lie inside the words Distant relation

explanation.surface: A far-off relative must get up early and stay sharp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' hides TRELA in 'Distant relation', and 'to be up' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone on the ball is quick and attentive, the same as being wide awake to things.

clue.text: Lost time moving on English parasite

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above, so the English letter comes beneath
moving means shifting position, so the letters of Lost time are rearranged

explanation.surface: Time lost moving on to an English parasite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' rearranges LOST TIME to give MISTLETO.
explanation.definitionFit: Mistletoe grows on trees and draws nutrients from its host, a plant parasite.

clue.text: Attractive old volunteers remain without answer

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's former volunteer reserve force

indicators.note: without means minus, so the answer letter is taken out of the remain word

parts.note: to stay is to remain

explanation.surface: An appealing band of old volunteers stays put without replying.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasty in British slang means sexually attractive, as well as having good flavour.

clue.text: Minister sees train regularly taken by nuisance

indicators.note: taken by means held inside, so the picked letters go within the nuisance word

parts.note: a pest is an annoying nuisance

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter of the word train is taken

explanation.surface: A government minister finds his train service routinely disrupted by some pest.
explanation.definitionFit: A minister of religion is a clergyman, and a priest is one such clergyman.

clue.text: Principal lover cut knot occasionally

indicators.note: cut means docked of its tail, so the lover word loses its final letter

parts.note: a paramour is an illicit lover

indicators.note: occasionally means every other letter of the word knot

explanation.surface: A main lover severs a knot now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: Paramount means supreme or chief, the same as principal as an adjective.

clue.text: Urge Independent politician to oppress the Spanish

indicators.note: in a down clue, to oppress is to weigh down from above, so the earlier letters sit over the Spanish article

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament
el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: A call for an Independent MP to crush Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: To impel is to drive or urge someone forward to act.

clue.text: Tell story and turn on article about fish rising

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above, so the turn word comes first

parts.note: to spin is to turn

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the article goes round the reversed fish

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means read upwards, so the fish word runs backwards

parts.note: a ray is a flat fish

explanation.surface: A storyteller spins round on a piece about a jumping fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' works only on the fish, and 'turn' is the spinning, not the reversal.
explanation.definitionFit: To spin a yarn is an idiom for telling a long, often embellished tale.

clue.text: Undaunted, the girl's voice is without limits

parts.note: her is the possessive for a girl, the girl's

indicators.note: without limits means losing both outer letters of the word voice

explanation.surface: A fearless girl's singing has no bounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Heroic means brave and bold in the face of danger, hence not daunted.

clue.text: Birds, for example, rest in flight

parts.note: EG is exempli gratia, for example

indicators.note: in flight means fleeing or scattering, so the letters of rest are mixed up

explanation.surface: Birds, such as these, rest while flying.
explanation.definitionFit: Egrets are white herons, wading birds.

clue.text: Level, yet still at the start

parts.note: yet and even both intensify, as in yet more or even more

indicators.note: at the start points to the first letter of the word still

explanation.surface: Something remains flat, and yet was still at the beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: Evens describes an equal, level state, as with even betting odds or a tied score.

clue.text: Robust binding

definitions.meaning: robust means big, sturdy and healthy-looking
binding means fastening with bands or straps

explanation.surface: A strong tie that holds firm.
explanation.definitionFit: A strapping lad is robust, and strapping is also the act of tying with straps.

clue.text: Perform better, needing expenditure to cover parking

indicators.note: to cover means to wrap round, so the spending word encloses the parking letter

parts.note: an outlay is money spent, an expenditure
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: A business does better but must spend money on car-park provision.
explanation.definitionFit: To outplay rivals is to beat them by playing better, so it means surpassing them.

clue.text: Macho guards fighting source of cyber invasion?

indicators.note: guards means surrounds protectively, so the macho word wraps around the fighting word

parts.note: male is used loosely for macho or manly
war is armed fighting

explanation.surface: Tough security guards are battling a hacking attack.
explanation.definitionFit: Malicious software such as viruses and trojans is the means by which hackers attack computers.

clue.text: Drink mint tea, we hear — right with vichy water

parts.note: to mint is to make money, and a coin is a minted piece

indicators.note: we hear signals that the word tea is taken for how it is spoken, a single letter

parts.note: the drink tea is pronounced like the letter T
Vichy is a French spa town, and eau is French for water

explanation.surface: Someone orders mint tea and then a glass of Vichy mineral water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mint' looks like a herb flavouring the tea, but it is the coin-maker.
explanation.definitionFit: Cointreau is a French orange-flavoured liqueur, an alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Inject iodine and clean out after surgery

parts.note: I is the chemical symbol for iodine

indicators.note: after surgery means operated on and changed, so the letters of clean out are rearranged

explanation.surface: A medical routine: inject iodine and clean the wound after an operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after surgery' reads as a time phrase in the surface but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To inoculate is to inject a vaccine to give immunity against a disease.

clue.text: Humiliate Hebridean island in terrible mess

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the island name goes within the scrambled letters
terrible means very bad, so the letters of mess are jumbled

parts.note: Barra is an island in Scotland's Outer Hebrides

explanation.surface: A Scottish island shamed by an awful mess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terrible' is the anagram signal; the island splits the rearranged letters of the mess.
explanation.definitionFit: To embarrass is to make someone feel awkward and ashamed, to humiliate them.

clue.text: Boasts of loads welcoming Republican

indicators.note: welcoming means taking in, so the loads word holds the Republican letter

parts.note: bags of means loads of, plenty

explanation.surface: Someone boasts about plenty of loads taken in by a US party member.
explanation.definitionFit: To brag is to boast, so the third-person verb forms match exactly.

clue.text: Analyse nervous collapse

definitions.meaning: to analyse is to divide data into categories and examine them

explanation.surface: Study a mental crisis.
explanation.definitionFit: A breakdown is both an itemised analysis and a nervous collapse; the verb sense is the phrase break down.

clue.text: Runs for son in selected task

indicators.note: for means in place of, so the runs letter replaces the son letter

parts.note: chose means selected
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son
R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A cricketer's runs stand in for a son on a chosen job.
explanation.definitionFit: A chore is a routine, often tedious job around the house, a task.

clue.text: Ill-tempered taxi driver having to cross river

indicators.note: having to cross means spanning something, so the taxi driver word goes around the river letter

parts.note: a cabby drives a cab
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A grumpy cab driver must take the bridge over the river.
explanation.definitionFit: Crabby means grumpy and irritable, sour-tempered like a crab apple.

clue.text: Speak on British fruit tree

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the speaking word follows the British letter

parts.note: to utter is to speak
a nut is a hard-shelled fruit

explanation.surface: Someone talks about a fruit tree from Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: The butternut is a North American walnut species, so it is a tree.

clue.text: Worked endlessly needing time for facilities

indicators.note: endlessly means without its final letter, so the worked word is docked

parts.note: toiled means worked hard

explanation.surface: Someone works non-stop and needs a break for the loo.
explanation.definitionFit: Facilities is a polite euphemism for a lavatory, as in asking where the facilities are.

clue.text: Raging fire following a question getting source of water

indicators.note: following means coming after, so the reworked fire letters come last
raging means wild and uncontrolled, so the letters of fire are mixed up

explanation.surface: A wild blaze is followed by questions about where the water came from.
explanation.definitionFit: An aquifer is an underground layer of porous rock holding water that feeds wells and springs.

clue.text: Holy man seeing a king hiding in tree

indicators.note: hiding in means concealed inside, so the a-and-king letters sit within the tree

parts.note: a fir is a conifer tree
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A holy man spots a king concealed in a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A fakir is a Muslim or Hindu ascetic who lives on alms, a religious holy man.

clue.text: Vegetable that's a hot pick cooked with no end of effort

indicators.note: cooked means altered or doctored, so the letters are rearranged
with no says one letter must be left out of the mixed letters
end of points to the last letter of the word effort

explanation.surface: A spicy pick of vegetables gets cooked without much effort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' rearranges A HOT PICK, and 'with no' 'end of effort' removes its T, leaving PAKCHOI.
explanation.definitionFit: Pak choi is a Chinese cabbage with white stalks and dark leaves, eaten as a vegetable.

clue.text: Fine during exercise on day, getting jabbed

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means sitting above, so the day letter comes below
during means inside the time of, so the fine word goes within the exercise letters

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercise
OK means fine, all right

explanation.surface: Fine during a workout, but then on the day someone gets a jab.
explanation.definitionFit: Poked means prodded with a finger or stick, which is to be jabbed.

clue.text: People who succeed in getting tunes broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means sent out on air, so the word for tunes is taken as it sounds

parts.note: airs are tunes or melodies

explanation.surface: Successful people get their songs played on radio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'People who succeed' looks like achievers; it means successors.
explanation.definitionFit: Heirs are those who inherit, succeeding to a title or estate.

clue.text: Need Juliet in support for game

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the need and Juliet letters go within the support word

parts.note: to back is to support
lack means need or want
J is Juliet in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Romeo's Juliet needs support to play.
explanation.definitionFit: Blackjack is a casino card game, also called twenty-one or pontoon.

clue.text: Oil producer's old tale about volume

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the tale word goes around the volume letter

parts.note: a tale can be a lie, a fib

explanation.surface: An oil company spins an old story about production volume.
explanation.definitionFit: The olive is pressed to make olive oil, so the fruit or its tree yields oil.

clue.text: Tries tucking in top of trouser suit

indicators.note: tucking in means putting inside, so the court word takes in the picked letter

parts.note: a judge tries or hears a case

indicators.note: top of picks the first letter of the word trouser

explanation.surface: Someone attempts to tuck a trouser top into a suit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suit' looks like clothing beside 'trouser', but it is the card suit.
explanation.definitionFit: Hearts is one of the four suits in a pack of playing cards.

clue.text: European province involved in strike

indicators.note: involved in means wrapped inside, so the province letters sit within the strike word

parts.note: to dash is to strike violently, as dashed against rocks
NI is Northern Ireland, often called the Province

explanation.surface: A European region gets caught up in industrial action.
explanation.definitionFit: A Dane, someone from Denmark, is Danish, so the adjective names a kind of European.
